note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient conversation) exactly as it appeared.
- The differential diagnosis (DDx) in the format you have (if possible, as JSON). If you have a list, you can paste it as bullet points; I will convert it to the required format and note any conflicts.

What I will deliver once you provide the data:
- Subjective:
  - Presenting complaint, onset, duration, progression
  - Past medical history, previous surgeries (if mentioned)
  - Medications (and any note when dose/route/frequency is not documented)
  - Social history (if mentioned)
  - Allergies (if mentioned)
- Objective:
  - Physical examination findings (with body side/site and specifics)
  - Investigations and results (if provided)
- Assessment & Plan:
  - For each Issue/Problem/Request (1, 2, 3, ...):
    - Name of the issue
    - Assessment/likely diagnosis
    - Differential diagnoses (from DDx only if consistent with transcript; include “conflict noted” if conflicting)
    - Investigations planned (if any)
    - Treatment planned (if any)
    - Referrals (if any)
- Quality checks:
  - Note any missing elements (e.g., meds reconciliation, allergies)
  - Mark any internal conflicts between transcript and DDx
  - Comment on transcript quality if noisy or inaudible

Formatting note:
- American English, concise, professional
- Use the exact headings and structure you specified
- Do not add facts beyond what the transcript or DDx provides

Please paste the transcript and the DDx data, and I will generate the completed SOAP note.
